question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Throw cold water on
solution:
The correct answer is: **To show indifference**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• The idiom "**throw cold water on**" means to discourage or show disapproval towards something. (किसी चीज़ के प्रति हतोत्साहित करना या अस्वीकृति दिखाना)
 
• It can also mean to dampen someone's enthusiasm or excitement about something.
 
• The phrase is often used in a negative context.
 
 
• **Example**: *Don't throw cold water on my plans.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
